Create a booking (DEPRECATED) Deprecated

DEPRECATED: This endpoint has been deprecated. Please use the two-step booking flow instead:

  1. POST /api/v1/bookings/initiate - Creates a draft booking
  2. PATCH /api/v1/bookings/{id}/finalize - Finalizes the booking with payment intent

This endpoint now returns 410 Gone with a deprecation message.

Authorizations:
jwtAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Booking request payload

check_in
required
string <date-time>
check_out
required
string <date-time>
object
duration_type
string
Enum: "hours" "days" "weeks" "minutes"

Duration unit for the booking

duration_value
integer

Duration value (e.g., 2 hours, 3 days, 1 week)

guest_id
required
string
guests
required
integer
listing_id
required
string
notes
string
payment_id
string
promo_code
string
referral_code
string
space_type
string
Enum: "couchsurf" "workspace" "storage" "shower" "parking"

Type of space being booked

Get all draft bookings for user

Retrieve all active draft bookings for the authenticated user. Returns all draft bookings that are not expired and have valid check-in dates, ordered by creation date (most recent first). Limited to 10 most recent drafts.

Initiate a booking (draft)

Creates a draft booking with minimal information. Guest ID is extracted from JWT token. Returns a booking ID that can be used to create a payment intent and finalize the booking later.

Authorizations:
jwtAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Minimal booking initiation payload

category
string
Enum: "couchsurf" "workspace" "storage" "shower" "parking"

Optional category code for filtering/follow-up purposes

check_in
string <date-time>

Optional check-in date and time. If provided, will be stored in draft booking.

check_out
string <date-time>

Optional check-out date and time. If provided, will be stored in draft booking.

guests
integer >= 1

Optional number of guests. If provided, will be stored in draft booking.

listing_id
required
string

ID of the listing to book

Responses

https://app-staging-gateway-8ua0taf7.uc.gateway.dev/api/v1/bookings/initiate

Request samples

Content type

  • "category": "couchsurf",
  • "check_in": "2025-09-15T14:00:00Z",
  • "check_out": "2025-09-18T11:00:00Z",
  • "guests": 2,
  • "listing_id": "lst_123456"
}

listing

Get all listings

Returns listings with optional filters. Supports keyword search, amenities (CSV up to 10), price range, dates, rating, gender, and pagination via limit/offset.

query Parameters
q
string

Keyword search (title/description)

latitude
number <double>

Latitude of the user's location

longitude
number <double>

Longitude of the user's location

category
string

Category code from CategoryMeta registry. If provided, must be a valid category code; empty values are rejected with 400.

country
string

ISO2 country code to filter listings (e.g., CA)

city
string

City name to filter listings (exact match)

start_date
string <date-time>

Start date for availability check (ISO 8601)

end_date
string <date-time>

End date for availability check (ISO 8601)

price_min
number <double>

Minimum price filter

price_max
number <double>

Maximum price filter

gender
string

Filter by host gender

page
integer >= 1
Default: 1

Page number (starts at 1)

limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 10

Number of items per page

offset
integer >= 0

Offset for pagination (alternative to page)

Responses

Submit voice verification request

Submit voice verification with audio file for voice biometrics.

Language Support: Include Accept-Language header to receive localized responses:

  • en or en-US for English (default)
  • fr or fr-FR for French
  • es or es-ES for Spanish

Example: Accept-Language: fr-FR,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8

Authorizations:
jwtAuth
header Parameters
Accept-Language
string
Default: en
Enum: "en" "en-US" "fr" "fr-FR" "es" "es-ES"

Preferred language for response messages

Request Body schema: application/json
required
audio_url
required
string <uri>

device_info
object
Default: {}

Device information for security

metadata

Default: {}
